$comment: Where the passkey wallet lets a swap's partner fee go, committed with the code rather than set in the environment. Change only through a reviewed commit (CONTRIBUTING.md). receivers: addresses a plain fee may go to; must contain exclip.config.ts fees.receiver whenever fees.partnerFeeBps or fees.rate is above 0 (the build warns when it doesn't). factories: FeeSplitterFactory contracts on Sonic, {address, platformName, platform, platformRate, maxTotalRate, initCodeHash}, each value read from the chain by the reviewer (contracts/fee-split/README.md); the config check refuses a fees.split whose factory isn't here. splits: {factory, operator, operatorRate}, an operator's split under a listed factory; the build stops on one the factory would refuse. Empty lists: the wallet refuses every swap that carries a fee (fails closed). docs/fees.md and docs/fee-split.md.
